raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misclassified the resource by redefining “renewable” to include recyclability, selecting aluminum as renewable and dismissing trees as nonrenewable based on harvest rates. Renewability refers to natural replenishment on human timescales; trees are renewable when managed sustainably, while aluminum is recyclable but not renewable.
